situation: We run a small online candle shop. A label mix-up meant about 180 Fig & Cedar candles went out labelled Lavender between Sept 14 and 22. People are posting about it on Instagram. I'm the founder, Priya.
reply: Between 14 and 22 September, about 180 candles we sent as Lavender were actually Fig & Cedar with the wrong label. If yours smells woody rather than floral, that's why. Sorry, that's our mistake: a label roll was loaded on the wrong line. Everyone affected gets the right candle shipped free by 9 October, no action needed, and you can keep the Fig & Cedar. Labels are now checked against the batch sheet before every run. Not heard from us by Friday? Email hello@wickandhollowcandles.com and I'll sort it personally. Priya, founder
note: Small mistake, short post: what happened first, one sorry, then the automatic fix.

situation: 我们是一家火锅店，有顾客在大众点评发差评，说周六晚上服务员催他们快点吃完翻台，态度很差。确实是我们的问题，我想以店长身份公开回复。
reply: 非常抱歉周六晚上让您用餐时被催着离开，这不是我们该有的待客方式，问题出在我们的排位安排上，责任在店里。从这周起，我们不再对在座的客人提示用餐时长。我已经私信您，想把那桌的费用退还给您，也邀请您再来一次，我亲自招待。谢谢您直接告诉我们。店长 陈磊
note: 公开回复不点名员工，把责任揽在店里；具体退款放到私信里处理。

situation: We posted an apology after our meal-kit deliveries were two days late last week. The top comment says 'Words are cheap. Third time this year.' It's actually the second time. I'm the founder.
reply: Fair, and you're right to be fed up. It's been two late weeks this year, and that's two too many. Here's what's done so far: everyone affected has a free box credited to their account, and we've added a second courier for Thursday deliveries. I'll post an update on 13 October with our on-time rate since the change.
note: Agree with the feeling, correct the fact once without arguing, then point to actions and a dated update. Then post it.

situation: I own a small yoga studio. This morning I sent our class schedule email from my own Gmail and put all 212 members in the To line instead of BCC, so everyone's email addresses are visible. No other data. I want to email everyone.
reply:
Subject: An email mistake this morning, and what we've done
Hi everyone,
At 8:40 this morning our schedule email went to 212 members with every address visible, instead of hidden. Only email addresses were shared: no phone numbers, no payment details, nothing else. I'm sorry, that was my mistake, sending from my own account instead of our mailing tool. From now on every studio email goes through the mailing tool, which never shows addresses. Please delete this morning's email, and if anything odd arrives that seems to come from this list, reply here or call me on 0161 496 0732.
Maya, owner, Northside Yoga
note: A small data slip still gets its own email: exactly what was and wasn't shared, one sorry, one real change. Check your local notification rules before sending.

situation: Wir betreiben eine Kletterhalle in Leipzig. Am Samstag mussten wir wegen eines Wasserschadens schließen, haben das aber erst um 9 Uhr auf Instagram gepostet. Rund 60 Leute standen vor der Tür. Ich bin der Inhaber, Jonas.
reply:
Am Samstag, 26. September, war unsere Halle wegen eines Wasserschadens geschlossen, und wir haben das erst um 9 Uhr auf Instagram gepostet, als viele von euch schon vor der Tür standen. Rund 60 Leute sind umsonst gekommen, manche mit Kindern und langer Anfahrt. Das tut mir leid. Alle, die für Samstag gebucht hatten, bekommen den Eintritt bis Freitag, 2. Oktober, automatisch erstattet. Wer ohne Buchung da war, schreibt uns an hallo@kletterwerk-leipzig.de und bekommt einen Freieintritt. Schließungen schicken wir ab sofort per E-Mail und SMS an alle Buchungen und stellen sie auf die Startseite, nicht nur auf Instagram. Bei Fragen erreicht ihr mich direkt unter 0341 2298 410.
Jonas Berger, Inhaber
note: Local business, informal 'ihr': the refund is automatic and the fix is about the channel that failed.

situation: Our bakery's Instagram posted a joke yesterday calling gluten-free customers 'crazy'. A coeliac customer called it out and it's been shared about 300 times. I'm the owner, Dana, and I wrote the post.
reply: Yesterday this account posted a joke calling gluten-free customers 'crazy'. I wrote it, and it was wrong: for people with coeliac disease gluten-free is a medical need, and many of you trust us with exactly that. I'm sorry. The post is deleted, and from today every post is checked by a second person on our team before it goes up. If you want to tell me directly how this landed, I read every email at dana@crumbhousebakery.com. Dana, owner
note: The owner names herself as the author; no 'it was meant as a joke' defence.

situation: 我们是一家线上咖啡豆小店。9月26日到28日发出的一批耶加雪菲（批次0926）烘焙过度，有明显焦苦味，一共92单，已经有客人在小红书上说了。我是店主林悦，想发一条给这批客人的消息，同时挂在店铺首页。
reply: 9月26日至28日发出的耶加雪菲（批次0926）因为烘焙温度设错，豆子烘过了头，喝起来有明显的焦苦味，一共影响92位客人。对不起，这是我们的问题。10月2日（周五）前，我们会给每位客人免费寄出一包新烘的豆子，不需要任何操作；如果您更想退款，直接回复“退款”，当天处理。从这批开始，每一锅出炉后都会先杯测再装袋。有任何问题，私信店铺或加我微信 linyue_beans，我亲自回复。店主 林悦
note: 先说发生了什么、影响多少人，一句道歉，补救自动完成，改进只写一条做得到的。

situation: I run Ledgerly, a small invoicing app for about 4,000 freelancers. Yesterday, Monday, from 10am to 2:30pm nobody could send invoices because a database update failed, and about 900 invoices went out hours late. I'm the founder and want to post on LinkedIn and X.
reply: Yesterday from 10am to 2:30pm, nobody could send invoices from Ledgerly, and about 900 invoices went out hours late. Sorry, that's on us: a database update failed and we were too slow to roll it back. Every delayed invoice kept its original date, so your payment terms aren't affected. We now test every update on a copy of live data first, and roll back automatically after 10 minutes of errors. If a client says yours never arrived, email me at sam@ledgerly.app and I'll sort it the same day. Sam, founder
note: Match the size: a half-day outage gets a short post, one sorry, and a change you can actually verify.

situation: We run Ridgeback Outdoor, a small online gear shop. From Sunday evening to Monday afternoon our site showed the Trailbase 3-person tent at $39 instead of $390, a typo in a bulk price update. 62 orders came in and we're honouring them, but people who saw the price jump mid-checkout are annoyed on Facebook. I'm the owner, Sam.
reply: From Sunday evening until Monday afternoon, our site showed the Trailbase 3-person tent at $39 instead of $390, after a typo in a price update. We're honouring all 62 orders placed at that price, and they ship this week. Sorry to anyone who watched the price change mid-checkout; that's a frustrating thing to see. From now on, a second person checks every bulk price change before it goes live. Questions: sam@ridgebackoutdoor.com. Sam, owner.
note: A pricing slip needs a short post: the facts, one sorry, what you're honouring, and one check you can actually keep.

situation: We're a two-person studio making a card game, Tidepool. 1,400 people pre-ordered and we promised shipping by October 15. We approved a print proof with a colour error on the reef cards and missed it, so the run is being reprinted and now ships November 26. I'm co-founder Leah and want to email everyone.
reply:
Subject: Tidepool is shipping late, and why
Hi everyone,
Tidepool won't ship by October 15 as promised; it will ship on November 26. We approved a print proof with the wrong colours on the reef cards and didn't catch it, so the whole run is being reprinted. I'm sorry, that miss was ours. You don't need to do anything: your order stands, and every copy will include an extra promo card. If you'd rather not wait, reply 'refund' any time before it ships and your money will be back within five days. From now on we check a printed proof, not just the PDF, before anything goes to press.
Leah, co-founder
note: A broken promise is a public apology too: the new date first, own the miss without blaming the printer, and make the refund one word.

situation: We run Marlow Books. At our author event on Saturday the step-free side door was locked and nobody was on it, so a wheelchair user, Dee, waited 25 minutes outside and missed the reading. She posted about it on Instagram and tagged us. I'm the owner, Sophie.
reply: Dee, you're right and I'm sorry. On Saturday our step-free door was locked with nobody there to open it, so you waited 25 minutes outside and missed the reading you came for. That's on us as a shop. I've sent you a DM to refund your ticket and to send you a signed copy of the book if you'd like one. From this week the side door is unlocked and staffed from 30 minutes before every event. Sophie, owner.
note: Reply where she posted, own it as the business without blaming a staff member, name one concrete change, and move the refund to DM.

situation: 我们是一家连锁瑜伽馆，会员都在小程序上续费。9月28日续费系统出错，大约310位月卡会员被重复扣了一次月费，每人299元。已经有会员在群里和小红书上问了。我是创始人周蔓，想发一条公告。
reply: 9月28日，我们小程序的续费系统出错，约310位月卡会员被重复扣了一次299元的月费。对不起，这是我们的问题。多扣的款会在10月2日（周五）前原路退回，不需要任何操作，到账时会收到短信。从今天起，每次续费扣款前系统都会先核对有没有重复订单。10月2日后还没收到退款，请私信小程序客服或加我微信 zhouman_yoga，我亲自处理。创始人 周蔓
note: 扣错钱的道歉：先说金额和人数，一句道歉，退款自动完成并给出日期，改进只写一条做得到的。

situation: We run Butter & Rye, a bakery. Our 'nut-free' oat cookies sold on Saturday and Sunday (Sept 26 and 27) were baked on trays also used for almond biscotti, so they may contain traces of almond. About 70 were sold and nobody has reported a reaction yet. I'm the owner, Grace, and want to post on Instagram, our website and a sign in the shop.
reply: If you bought our oat cookies labelled 'nut-free' on Saturday 26 or Sunday 27 September, please don't give them to anyone with a nut allergy. They were baked on trays also used for almond biscotti and may contain traces of almond; about 70 were sold. I'm sorry, that's our mistake. We've pulled the batch, and from today nut-free bakes have their own trays and go in the oven before anything with nuts. Bring the cookies back, or just tell us you bought them, for a full refund. If anyone has had a reaction, please get medical help first, then call me directly on 0117 496 0215. Grace, owner, Butter & Rye
note: A safety issue leads with who is at risk and what to do, before the sorry. Check with your local food safety authority whether you need to report it.

situation: Two weeks ago our dog daycare's only van broke down and about 40 dogs got home up to three hours late. My apology post promised an update by Thursday 1 October on what we'd change. We now have a second van on standby and owners get a text if a drop-off runs over 20 minutes late. Everyone affected was refunded for that day. I'm the owner, Jade.
reply: As promised on 17 September, here's the update. When our van broke down that day, about 40 of your dogs got home up to three hours late, and many of you were left waiting with no word from us. What's changed: a second van is now on standby every day, and if a drop-off is running more than 20 minutes late you'll get a text straight away with a new time. All 40 families have been refunded for that day. If anything still isn't right, email me at jade@muddypawsdaycare.co.uk and I'll reply personally. Jade, owner
note: The follow-up post is the promise kept: short recap, what changed, what's done. No second round of apologies.

situation: 我们是一家奶茶店，发朋友圈和小红书说9月29日全天第二杯半价，结果下午2点原料就用完了，很多人白跑一趟，评论里有人说我们骗流量。我是店主阿杰。
reply: 9月29日我们说好全天第二杯半价，结果下午2点原料就用完了，之后来的朋友都白跑了一趟。对不起，是我们备货估少了，说了全天就该做到全天。当天没买上的朋友，10月8日前到店说一声，第二杯半价照样给您补上，不需要任何凭证。以后做活动，我们会写清限量多少杯，卖完第一时间在门口和线上同步。有问题直接私信店铺，我本人回复。店主 阿杰
note: 活动没兑现也是公开道歉：先说承诺了什么、哪里没做到，一句道歉，补偿不设门槛，改进只写一条做得到的。
